title: Playlist and Locker
author: Rosalind Amberdale
blurb: Gideon Okonkwo, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before the last game of the season.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
